Q5563.reason: Thiazides, low-dose aspirin and other drugs can precipitate gout; diarrhoea is relevant (reactive/IBD arthritis), chair-rise difficulty is proximal weakness not diagnostic of PMR, and only prolonged stiffness suggests inflammatory arthropathy.

Q5568.reason: The client hired the accountant independently so attorney-client privilege and work product do not cover her statements to him, the Fifth Amendment does not bar a third party's testimony, and those statements are party-opponent admissions.

Q5571.reason: Nail pitting is a classic clue to psoriatic arthritis; skin plaques may be absent, there is no confirmatory blood marker, and tophi are a feature of gout.
